`_readClassicSubstitutions` interprets entry offsets as signed and sets the first glyph index to `max(0, ceil(substOffset / 2) - offset)`. Consequently, every replacement word read starts at byte offset `2 * (offset + glyphIndex) >= substOffset`, for both negative and positive entry offsets; if no eligible glyphs remain, nothing is read.
